version.value: Russian folk song arranged by Fyodor Chaliapin and Fyodor Keneman; bass and orchestra

performers.note: The source does not identify an orchestra by name.

date.note: 1928 is the release year, not the performance date.

matrixTakeSides.note: Commons and the discography identify take 1. The upstream table says “CC-11709-2” but also gives “CC 11709I”; its own cited reference says take 1. The discography lists take 2 as unpublished.

credits.value: Swiss Foundation Public Domain; Martin Osterwalder collection
credits.note: Collection and institutional transfer provenance are documented; no individual engineer is named.

date.note: The 21 April 2016 Commons upload is not a transfer date.

processing.value: Record cleaning machine and ELP laser turntable
processing.note: The source categories identify Keith Monks Archivist Duo Omni, RCM Mk. IX, and ELP LT-2XA. Detailed restoration, pitch adjustment and equalisation are not documented.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative; one source file, no concatenation or audio edits by Contrapunctus

composition.value: Traditional melody; Chaliapin–Keneman arrangement is public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms
composition.note: The source gives the arrangers’ deaths as 1938 and 1937. No claim of worldwide clearance is made.

recording.value: territorial — European public domain; first published 1928
recording.note: Allowed on documented publication before 1963: the former 50-year recording term expired before the 2013 extension. US recording status is not established. Commons’ PD-old-70 composition tag is not treated as a recording licence; the upstream item contains no non-commercial restriction. Upstream worldwide/US expiry assertions are not adopted.

rights.creditLine: Song of the Volga Boatmen; Fyodor Chaliapin, bass; orchestra conducted by Albert Coates. London, 20 October 1927; Disque “Gramophone” DB 1103, released 1928. Swiss Foundation Public Domain / Martin Osterwalder collection, via Wikimedia Commons. Recording rights: territorial European public domain; US status unestablished.
